item.title: EU egg prices continue upward trend in week 8
item.description: The average EU price for Class A eggs reached €293.49 per 100 kg in week 8 of 2026, according to the latest weekly report from the European Commission (DG AGRI, Animal Products). item.title: UK suspends certain argentine poultry imports following HPAI outbreak
item.description: The United Kingdom has suspended imports of specific poultry commodities from Argentina following the confirmation of a highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreak.
